## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `cmake --build build` succeeds
- [ ] `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` succeeds, or skipped tests are explained
- [ ] New or changed behavior has test coverage
- [ ] Public API, operational, and security changes are documented
- [ ] Protocol and persisted-state compatibility were considered

## Operational impact

Note required privileges, migration steps, performance impact, and rollback behavior. Write “none” when not applicable.
